l.i: Gehenna eft domus cruciatus, qui durat sine

main_text.l: diffipatione[?], seu fine. Hinc quando oratur
apud Orientales pro Defunctis, fupplica-
tur Deus, vt animas eorum eruat a poenis
Sciul siue Inferorum: At nunquam a poenis
Gehennæ, a quibus nulla est redemptio; etsi
oretur, ne mittantur in eam. In quo qui-
dem sensu intelligendum venit illud Eccle-
siæ Romanæ in Officio Defunctorum:

l.i: A porta Inferi erue Domine animas eorum.

main_text.l: Demonstrauimus præterea in ipsis notis,
suffragia viuorum pro Defunctorum ani-
mabus, nihil prodesse Damnatis, & id ex
capite 39. Constit. Ecclesiæ Maronitarum,
& Melchitarum, cap. 22. Cophtitarum,
& cap. 5. sect. 1. Iacobitarum; vbi verba
referuntur traditionis Apostolicæ, ac inter
cætera dicitur: Et sane credimus, id fieri

l.i: pro illis, qui præditi sunt continentia, fide,
erogaretur quicquid in hoc mundo bonorum est,

main_text.l: nihil illis proderit. Hanc eandem traditio-
nem Apostolicam sub Iacobi nomine to-
tidem, ac numeratis verbis refert Hebed-
ie-su libro supra laudato, titulo [illegible, ~6 letters]

page.notes: The top line (running head) and the final word of the page are in Arabic script and could not be read; the foot-left Arabic line is outside the text block and was not transcribed. "Sciul" and the first-line word "sine" are doubtful; "fine" may be read differently. Hebediesu is a line-end break with a printed hyphen, kept as printed. The page has no marginal notes.
